name: Woof You to the Moon
source:
Red is the color of love, but it's also the color of blood... which one will flow tonight? You have until the full moon rises to help a soon-to-be werewolf and his friends figure it out!

[From [url=https://axerwan.itch.io/woof-you-to-the-moon]itch.io[/url]]
